hcontainer.p: (156) See In re Application of United States, 610 F.2d 1148, 1157 (3d Cir. 1979) (holding that “due process requires a hearing on the issue of burdensomeness before compelling a telephone company to provide” assistance with a search warrant) and In re Application of United States, 616 F.2d 1122 (9th Cir. 1980).
